text:
Male patients are asked to bring their own electric razor because hospitals often don't supply razors, and a personal electric razor avoids the nicks and skin breaks that disposable blades cause, which raise infection risk. It also avoids the risk of shared or reused razors passing blood and skin between patients. Guidelines usually favour clipping hair over shaving before surgery, so staff may still tell you not to shave at all.

CONFIDENCE: 70
